name: unqualified-binary
sql: SELECT 'a'::text %% 'b'::text AS result

name: qualified-overload
sql: SELECT 1 OPERATOR(public.%%) 2 AS result

name: prefix
sql: SELECT OPERATOR(public.%%) 1 AS result

name: strict-null
sql: SELECT NULL::text %% 'b'::text AS result

name: duplicate
sql: CREATE OPERATOR %% (LEFTARG=integer, RIGHTARG=integer, FUNCTION=int4pl)

name: wrong-signature
sql: CREATE OPERATOR !!! (RIGHTARG=bigint, FUNCTION=int4um)

name: postfix
sql: CREATE OPERATOR !!! (LEFTARG=integer, FUNCTION=int4um)

name: unknown-type
sql: CREATE OPERATOR !!! (RIGHTARG=absent_type, FUNCTION=int4um)

name: with-estimators
sql: SELECT 1 OPERATOR(public.@#@#) 2 AS result

name: valid-declaration
sql: CREATE OPERATOR public.!!! (RIGHTARG=integer, FUNCTION=pg_catalog.int4um)

name: commutator-result-mismatch
sql: CREATE OPERATOR public.!!! (LEFTARG=integer, RIGHTARG=integer, FUNCTION=int4pl, COMMUTATOR=OPERATOR(pg_catalog.=))

name: alter-cube-le
sql: ALTER OPERATOR <= (cube, cube) SET (RESTRICT = scalarlesel, JOIN = scalarlejoinsel)

name: alter-cube-ge
sql: ALTER OPERATOR >= (cube, cube) SET (RESTRICT = scalargesel, JOIN = scalargejoinsel)

name: alter-seg-le
sql: ALTER OPERATOR <= (seg, seg) SET (RESTRICT = scalarlesel, JOIN = scalarlejoinsel)

name: alter-seg-ge
sql: ALTER OPERATOR >= (seg, seg) SET (RESTRICT = scalargesel, JOIN = scalargejoinsel)

name: alter-trgm-similarity
sql: ALTER OPERATOR % (text, text) SET (RESTRICT = matchingsel, JOIN = matchingjoinsel)

name: alter-trgm-word
sql: ALTER OPERATOR <% (text, text) SET (RESTRICT = matchingsel, JOIN = matchingjoinsel)

name: alter-trgm-word-reverse
sql: ALTER OPERATOR %> (text, text) SET (RESTRICT = matchingsel, JOIN = matchingjoinsel)

name: alter-trgm-strict-word
sql: ALTER OPERATOR <<% (text, text) SET (RESTRICT = matchingsel, JOIN = matchingjoinsel)

name: alter-trgm-strict-word-reverse
sql: ALTER OPERATOR %>> (text, text) SET (RESTRICT = matchingsel, JOIN = matchingjoinsel)

name: alter-prefix-estimator
sql: ALTER OPERATOR public.?# (NONE, integer) SET (RESTRICT = pg_catalog.contsel)

name: alter-prefix-join
sql: ALTER OPERATOR public.?# (NONE, integer) SET (JOIN = pg_catalog.contjoinsel)

name: alter-builtin-reset
sql: ALTER OPERATOR pg_catalog.= (integer, integer) SET (RESTRICT = NONE)

name: alter-builtin-enabled-hashes
sql: ALTER OPERATOR pg_catalog.= (integer, integer) SET (HASHES = off)

name: alter-builtin-enabled-merges
sql: ALTER OPERATOR pg_catalog.= (integer, integer) SET (MERGES = false)

name: alter-existing-commutator
sql: ALTER OPERATOR public.@#@# (integer, integer) SET (COMMUTATOR = OPERATOR(public.@#@#))

name: alter-negator
sql: ALTER OPERATOR public.@#@# (integer, integer) SET (NEGATOR = OPERATOR(public.?@))

name: alter-self-negation
sql: ALTER OPERATOR public.@#@# (integer, integer) SET (NEGATOR = OPERATOR(public.@#@#))

name: alter-missing-signature
sql: ALTER OPERATOR public.@#@# (smallint, smallint) SET (RESTRICT = NONE)

name: alter-opaque-estimator
sql: ALTER OPERATOR public.@#@# (integer, integer) SET (RESTRICT = public.no_estimator)

name: alter-immutable-function
sql: ALTER OPERATOR public.@#@# (integer, integer) SET (FUNCTION = pg_catalog.int4eq)

name: alter-unknown-setting
sql: ALTER OPERATOR public.@#@# (integer, integer) SET (unknown_setting = true)

name: alter-commutator-result-mismatch
sql: ALTER OPERATOR public.%% (integer, integer) SET (COMMUTATOR = OPERATOR(public.?@))

name: alter-negator-result-mismatch
sql: ALTER OPERATOR public.?@ (integer, integer) SET (NEGATOR = OPERATOR(public.%%))

name: cross-schema-distinct-signature
sql: SELECT 1 @@ 2 AS result

name: qualified-cross-schema-signature
sql: SELECT 1 OPERATOR(public.@@) 2 AS result
